description:
Stage log entries in the vault's buffer, validate them, and flush them to per-thread daily logs.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date DATE] — add an UNKNOWN raw capture. Blocks flush until removed; avoid it.
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date DATE] — add a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date DATE] — add a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID] [--date DATE] — add an ACTION, which becomes a task on flush
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup by (thread, date) and validate. Idempotent.
  flush — tend, write entries to logs/, clear the buffer, then ingest the flushed ACTIONs into tasks

Args:
  THREAD       thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink. Must resolve to an existing thread.
  TEXT         one line of text. For add-action: '(Assignee) description' or 'description'.
  TARGET       wikilink target: notes/<stem>, logs/<path>, people/<name>, hours/<Kind>/<Thread>, payments/<Kind>/<Thread>, or <Kind>/<Thread>
  SUMMARY      optional words shown after the link
  FILTER       case-insensitive substring
  LINE_NUMBER  integer, from `list`

Flags:
  add / add-text / add-ref / add-action:
    --date YYYY-MM-DD   file under this day (default today). Use the day the thing happened, not the day it is recorded.
  add-action:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD
    --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8     task this one waits on; repeatable
  list:
    --json              JSON output
  top-level, before the subcommand:
    --quiet             suppress info output

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/SGB", "Validated detection patterns; join semantics unresolved."]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/SGB", "notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00", "Kickoff minutes"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Draft proposal", "--due", "2026-10-09", "--priority", "M"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Never edit buffer.md directly. To fix an entry, `rm` it and re-add it with the right add-* command.
  An UNKNOWN entry from `add` fails tend and blocks flush. Convert it: `rm` it, then use add-text, add-ref or add-action.
  Line numbers can shift. Run `list` again before each `rm`.
  flush writes log files and clears the buffer. Do not run `tasks` after it; flush already ingests. An ACTION that is already an open task is skipped ('already a task: ...'), and a duplicate within the buffer is skipped ('already buffered').
  Exit 1: line number not an integer, out of range or empty; any validation error.
